name_zh: 不丹·吉格梅·凯萨尔：龙王民主与宪法幸福
name_en: Bhutan Jigme Khesar: Dragon King Democracy & Constitution Happiness
description_zh: 吉格梅·凯萨尔·纳姆耶尔·旺楚克 (1980-) 不丹第五世国王 (2006-)，2008年推行民主宪法改革，父亲吉格梅·辛格·旺楚克创立GNH国民幸福总值指标，退位让位年轻国王完成民主转型。
description_en: Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck (1980-) Bhutan 5th King (2006-), 2008 democratic constitutional reform, father Jigme Singye Wangchuck created GNH Gross National Happiness index, abdicated young king completing democratic transition.
reason_zh: 吉格梅五世代表君主制主动退让推动民主化的罕见案例，展示了GNH幸福指标如何作为发展替代范式指导国家政策，君主退位完成从绝对君主到立宪君主的和平转型。
reason_en: Jigme V represents rare case of monarchy proactively yielding driving democratization, demonstrating how GNH happiness index guides national policy as development alternative paradigm, monarch abdication completing peaceful transition from absolute to constitutional monarchy.
steps_zh: 研究吉格梅五世早年牛津教育与王储准备
分析2006年父亲退位与2008年民主宪法颁布
探讨GNH国民幸福总值四支柱九领域指标体系
评估年轻国王现代化外交与印度中国平衡
总结龙王民主宪法幸福对小国发展模式的独特贡献
steps_en: Study Jigme V early Oxford education and crown prince preparation
Analyze 2006 father abdication and 2008 democratic constitution promulgation
Explore GNH Gross National Happiness four pillars nine domains indicator system
Evaluate young king modernization diplomacy and India China balance
Summarize dragon king democracy constitution happiness unique contribution for small state development model
expected_zh: 掌握君主主动民主化与幸福指标治理双重创新，理解小国如何通过文化软实力指标超越GDP单一追求，评估不丹模式对全球发展测量的范式挑战。
expected_en: Master monarchy proactive democratization and happiness governance dual innovation, understand how small state transcends GDP single pursuit through cultural soft power indicators, evaluate Bhutan model paradigm challenge for global development measurement.
case_zh: 1980 出生；2006 即位；2008 宪法；GNH指标。龙王民主宪法幸福范式永存。
case_en: 1980 birth; 2006 accession; 2008 Constitution; GNH index. Dragon king democracy constitution happiness paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: GNH index; peaceful democratization; happiness development; constitutional monarchy
